purpose: Brand strategy and visual-identity analysis; not product or medical recommendations.
method: Current official websites reviewed through web retrieval and HTML requests; exact images extracted from official HTML, responsive sources, product metadata or image-search results for official product pages, then fetched and visually checked.
editorialNotes: Interpretive fields are authored analyst readings, not factual brand claims.
Voice lines are illustrative, authored examples and are not quotations.
Palette hex values are approximate editorial readings of observed identity, not official brand specifications.
Category scope reflects the reviewed catalogue; stock and assortments can change.

brands.name: Evereden
verifiedFacts: Official navigation separates kids, teens, Mom & Baby; kids’ skincare/haircare, deodorant and fragrance mists are listed.
The Kids Daily 1-2-3 Routine page includes face wash, face cream and a sunscreen product.
The homepage currently foregrounds youth self-care, routine bundles and a Polly Pocket collaboration.
brands.scopeNote: No cosmetics tag: fragrance mists and deodorant alone were not treated as verified colour cosmetics. Specific age claims omitted because individual formats differ.

images.alt: Evereden kids’ face-care bottles in a coordinated routine
Evereden Happy Hair Trio colourful packaging

brands.name: Pipette
verifiedFacts: Official navigation includes Baby, Kids, Soothing and Suncare.
Catalogue lists baby shampoo/wash and lotion; kids’ shampoo, conditioner, detangler and face products; sunscreen lotion, spray and stick formats.
The story explicitly links visual simplicity to parents retaining their own identity and uses squalane as a recurring ingredient narrative.
brands.scopeNote: Many listed products showed Sold out at review; catalogue scope does not imply immediate availability.

images.alt: Pipette mineral sunscreen discovery trio packaging

brands.name: Tubby Todd
verifiedFacts: Official story says Andrea Faulkner Williams and her husband created the brand for their family’s sensitive-skin concerns.
The Regulars Bundle lists Hair + Body Wash, Everyday Lotion and All Over Ointment.
Official sunscreen category lists lotion, Mineral Mist, Mineral Sunstick and SPF lip balm, alongside sets.
Navigation offers Baby, Kids and Mama routines, plus hair, bath and oral-care categories.
brands.scopeNote: Catalogue and product pages showed Sold out for multiple items at review. Clinical claims and testimonial efficacy were excluded from the analysis.

images.alt: Tubby Todd Regulars Bundle pastel bottles and ointment jar
Tubby Todd travel kit with wash, lotion and ointment

brands.name: Dabble & Dollop
verifiedFacts: Official story describes a founder inspired by children mixing shampoos and bubble baths at a company Kids Science Day.
Official FAQ defines the 3-in-1 as shampoo, body wash and bubble bath.
Official navigation lists foaming whips and bubbles, bath bombs, conditioner and detangler, and baby care.
Official FAQ states the former Dabble Ducky infant line is now Dabble & Dollop Baby.
brands.scopeNote: Mixability is the brand proposition; no author endorsement of ingredient safety claims. Seasonal imagery is the official current holiday campaign.

images.alt: Dabble & Dollop rainbow bath bottles and illustrated gift box
Dabble & Dollop child holding bath-care bottles in a colourful campaign portrait

brands.name: Thinkbaby / Think
verifiedFacts: gothink.com redirects to thinksun.com.
Official architecture separates Baby, Kids, Sport and Daily sun care.
Current products include Thinkbaby lotion tubes and sticks; kids’ lotion, stick, spray and brush-on formats also appear.
Official navigation nests Body Care and Hardgoods under Last Chance.
brands.scopeNote: Current sun-care emphasis supersedes older hardgoods-led descriptions. Sunscreen formats are category facts, without application or health advice.

Thinkbaby white mineral sunscreen stick with orange lettering

brands.name: Nailmatic Kids
brands.audienceScope: Kids’ line; wider brand includes teens & adults
verifiedFacts: Official story defines a dedicated children’s universe within a wider family brand.
Official categories include water-based kids’ polish, lip gloss, body gel, Tattoopen, bath products and gift sets.
Brand story describes illustrated packaging intended to be coloured or reused.
Adult and teen nail products are separately listed; kids’ products are not treated as the full parent-brand assortment.
brands.scopeNote: Kids’ water-based polish is distinct from the wider brand’s plant-based teen/adult nail polish. No age range generalised across products.

brands.name: Minois Paris
verifiedFacts: Official story identifies Minois Paris as French-made baby and children’s care and names founder Hélène Fulchi.
Current English homepage explicitly extends the audience to the whole family and women’s care.
Homepage lists Delicate Gel, Gentle Cream and Body Lotion, with categories for bath, skincare, haircare and signature perfumes.
brands.scopeNote: The current brand is broader than a children-only skincare line. No sunscreen category was verified; no sun tag added.
